description: This file contains the implementation of a builder class `DeleteAttributesLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl` that constructs responses and events related to the deletion of attributes in a 'live' command context within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods for creating success responses and error events specific to attribute deletion commands.

classes.name: DeleteAttributesLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl
classes.description: A final class that implements a builder for creating command responses and events concerning attribute deletion in a live command context. Implements methods for generating success responses and error responses related to attribute accessibility and modifiability.

classes.name: ResponseFactoryImpl
classes.description: Immutable inner class implementing the ResponseFactory interface, creating specific response and error objects for attribute deletion commands.

classes.name: EventFactoryImpl
classes.description: Immutable inner class implementing the EventFactory interface, creating event objects for deleted attributes.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the builder for a given delete attributes command.

methods.name: doCreateResponse
methods.description: Creates a command response using the provided response factory function.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Creates an event object using the provided event factory function.
